verdicts.reason: Both crop the hero photo to a meaningless strip of nose and mouth, losing the face. Doodles (bulb, question mark, atom) pile up over the face, the question mark sits on the mouth, and the molecule doodle is cut off at the right edge. A's headline and its tiny 'PODCAST WITH' subtitle are smaller and harder to read. B's headline and subtitle are a little larger and fill the strip better, so B wins narrowly, but both are broken.
